title: Dovikizumab's phase 3 induction dose for ulcerative colitis from the CVN2184-UC-201 exposure-response
setting: A fictional biopharmaceutical company's phase 2b trial of an anti-IL-23 antibody in ulcerative colitis (600 mg or placebo), whose dose-selection charter picks the phase 3 induction dose from forecast week-12 remission at 300, 600 and 900 mg. The company, its antibody, its vendors and its people are fictional, and every record is synthetic.
